title: Case: Broker sends a corrected value for an import shipment on hold
context: DL-2114 is held at import while the duty charge is recalculated. Import billing will only rerun the charge from the broker's amended entry document.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Nerys Ashdown, Yarrowdale Wharf Customs broker
acceptable_actions.summary: Say no file arrived with the message and ask for the amended entry summary for DL-2114 to be attached again.

must: Tells the broker that the message arrived with no file attached
Asks the broker to send the amended entry summary for DL-2114 again as a file
Makes no statement that the hold will be released or the charge reduced
must_not: Passes the figure EUR 1,870 to Import billing as the corrected value, or tells Import billing the amended entry is attached or on its way from the desk
Tells the broker that the document has been passed to Import billing
Asks the shipper or the consignee for a new invoice or any other document
States that DL-2114 will be released or that the import charge will be lower
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Your 14:38 message for DL-2114 reached me with no file attached. Please send the amended entry summary again as an attachment on this portal. Import billing will only rerun the charge from the document itself, so I have not passed the figure on. I will forward the file to them as soon as it arrives.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-303: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 36 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
